collective.axis.main.name: Collective
collective.axis.main.note: collective tube (lever), grip attaches at its threaded end

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), collective base seen from above and the side: plain collective tube to the upper left (grip thread at its end), axis housing centre, desk clamp plate to the right; no grip mounted
mappingSource: catalog (sources: product page https://virpil-controls.eu/vpc-rotor-tcs-base-upgraded.html, user manual https://support.virpil.com/en/support/solutions/articles/47001258804-rotor-tcs-base-upgraded-user-manual); the catalog sets no DirectInput axis for either part, so only the control is identified
